data.body: CI review-sub-pr on PR1 #533 (integration attempt) returned 1 critical + 4 important. Triage: finding 1 (critical, closure NameError) = FALSE POSITIVE (def at indent-8 BEFORE the if/else at indent-8, bound unconditionally -> in scope; verified). Finding 2 = reviewer-acknowledged FP. Findings 3/4/5 + inline (config_path, max_calls, mixed-cluster, stale comment) = legit-minor. Fixing the legit ones + combining with #2 (dc57, branch feat/fp-2-symbol-injection 6041a433) on one branch, then re-integrating.
